changes_made.explanation: Added datasets mentioned in experiments (Alpaca-GPT4, WizardLM, FLANv2), added Mistral-7B model, and clarified output types based on MT-Bench categories. Normalized task naming consistency.
Consolidated GPT-4 rating variants into standardized form. Added accuracy metric used for MMLU evaluation. Perplexity is used in the NUGGETS scoring method.
Removed Davinci-003 as it's the reference model being compared against, not the judge. Consolidated evaluation methods and kept the comprehensive criteria list from MT-Bench.
Confirmed no human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations used automatic metrics or LLM-as-judge approaches.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on instruction data selection methodology (NUGGETS) using one-shot learning scoring. Evaluation is comprehensive but automated, using GPT-4 ratings and pairwise comparisons. The extraction was generally accurate but missed some datasets used in additional experiments. Paper demonstrates that high-quality data selection outperforms full dataset training across multiple benchmarks.
